CheckTitle: Entra directory sync excludes the krbtgt_AzureAD account from synchronization
Description:
The on-premises **krbtgt_AzureAD** account created by `Set-AzureADKerberosServer` must not be synchronized to Microsoft Entra ID.

This check identifies synchronized users whose name attributes match krbtgt_AzureAD, indicating the sensitive Kerberos account has been synced across trust boundaries.
Risk: A synchronized krbtgt_AzureAD account exposes the keys Microsoft Entra ID uses to issue partial Kerberos TGTs for the on-premises domain. AD-side changes to the object flow into the cloud, creating a **privilege-escalation path** between the on-premises and cloud trust boundaries that an attacker with AD write access could exploit.

Code.Other:
1. In on-premises AD, locate the **krbtgt_AzureAD** account (by default in `CN=Users`)
2. Exclude it from synchronization using Microsoft Entra Connect wizard > Customize synchronization options > Domain and OU filtering, or attribute-based filtering with a sync rule. For Cloud Sync, adjust scoping filters in Microsoft Entra admin center > Entra ID > Entra Connect > Cloud sync > Configurations
3. Run a sync cycle (`Start-ADSyncSyncCycle -PolicyType Delta`) and confirm the synced object is removed from Entra ID
4. Do **not** delete or modify the on-premises krbtgt_AzureAD account itself

Recommendation.Text: Exclude the **krbtgt_AzureAD** account from directory synchronization scope using OU filtering or attribute-based sync rules. This keeps the on-premises Kerberos trust anchor isolated from the cloud trust boundary, following the principle of **separation of trust domains**.

Notes: Port of Maester test MT.1147 (Test-MtKrbtgtAzureADNotSynced). Only applies to hybrid tenants with on-premises directory synchronization. Cloud-only tenants receive a PASS as not applicable.
